Path: the customer's language | i18n.surface-matrix | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `a11y` · `priority:p3` · `domain:ui` · `area:i18n` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed — graded)

Triage: lands in `packages/fields/src/widgets/ImageField.tsx` (`readFileValues(value, 'Image')` makes the literal the name, so the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` fallback never runs) ⇒ `domain:ui`; rationale: every nameless image gets the English alt text and enlarge label "Image" in every locale, while the image cell renderer already computes the translated fallback from the value's own name (objectui#10493 retired the literal there). An a11y name in the wrong language ⇒ p3, as objectui#10493.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01CRZSc7dU8oDStbTbSwhuZe` · 2026-09-25T14:04Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch. Read: this card and its full thread, and objectui `origin/main`.

Execution note: follow the cell renderer. Pass no fallback name into `readFileValues`, and take the translated `fields.image.imageAlt` when the value has no name of its own; the lightbox takes the same name. Pin under `zh` with a bare-id value.
